postToolUse.bash: engine="$HOME/.impeccable/vaultdex/engine-0.1.5/impeccable"; case "${OSTYPE:-}" in msys*|cygwin*) engine="$engine.exe";; esac; if [ ! -x "$engine" ]; then echo 'Impeccable hook setup required: run node scripts/install-impeccable-hooks.mjs from a reviewed checkout.' >&2; exit 1; fi; "$engine" hook
postToolUse.powershell: $engine = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.impeccable/vaultdex/engine-0.1.5/impeccable.exe'; if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $engine)) { Write-Error 'Impeccable hook setup required: run node scripts/install-impeccable-hooks.mjs from a reviewed checkout.'; exit 1 }; & $engine hook; exit $LASTEXITCODE
